title: My First Coloring Book: Animals (Part 2)
developmental_focus: Fine-motor coloring practice (whole-hand/early tripod crayon grasp) paired with animal vocabulary, continuing from Part 1 with 8 additional animals.
safety_notes: One animal per page, single simple black-line outline on white, no fine internal detail.
All animals depicted in calm, friendly, standing/sitting poses -- no aggressive or predatory poses, consistent with Part 1.
Bear depicted as a friendly, non-threatening cub silhouette.
Line art only, no pre-filled color -- coloring is the point of this book.
Part 2 of an open vocabulary set -- no sequencing dependency on Part 1, can be read/colored in any order.
